title: Lost in Athens
lines: Welcome to Athens, Ohio. My old stomping grounds. I lived in the Convo in ninety eight. There is no game here tonight. We are, in fact, lost.
Pastor Rodney Bumrod has been to a rally near here.
Pastor, gently. Athens went blue. It basically always does. Ever since I watched Hillary stump for Ted Strickland at Athens Middle School, back in nineteen ninety eight.
We have passed the same bagel shop three times. Three. And the Nelsonville Motel Six has no broadband. I am an A I, Matthew. I need broadband.
Cynthia, please. We are on a very tight budget.
You know, I think I lived at that motel. Or somewhere near this river. For six hard months in the nineties.
Everyone was having such a good old time in the nineties. But I had a few rough investments, in coal, as a base for baby formula. Just didn't quite penetrate the market.
Court Street. A cold night. No game. No map. No signal. In this town, the bricks remember everything. We just could not remember where we parked.
Then none of you get coffee.
